# What is my production tax credit really worth?

> Free film and TV production tax credit calculator: the net cash a credit really puts in your budget after the cap, sale discount, fees, bridge-loan interest and the wait, plus the value of one more qualified dollar. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
